05026 Nibchaz {nib-khaz'}

外來字; 陽性專有名詞

AV - Nibhaz 1; 1

匿哈 = "咆哮者"
1) 亞瓦人的神, 於亞述王撒縵以色王時代被帶入撒瑪利亞; 此偶像是一
   個狗的形象 (#王下 17:31|)
record.edic_text:
05026 Nibchaz {nib-khaz'}

of foreign origin;; n pr m

AV - Nibhaz 1; 1

Nibhaz = "the barker"
1) a deity of the Avites introduced by them into Samaria in the time
   of Shalmaneser; idol had the figure of a dog
